parameters.content:
## Store 4 · Buyer guides

A short buyer's guide for each of your top collections, written from what the collection actually stocks, approved in Slack and shown on the collection page.

1. **Pick collections** takes collections whose intro you've approved in **Store 4 · Collection copy**, highest search volume first, `max_per_run` at a time (redrafts first).
2. **Read the collection** gets its live products and their `custom` metafields, the specs that product data enrichment writes.
3. **People also ask** (DataForSEO, about US$0.002 a search) collects the questions shoppers ask Google about the collection's keyword. They steer the headings; Google's answers are never used. Disable the node to skip it.
4. The model writes 3 or 4 short sections from those specs only. **Check the guide** flags any number that isn't in the specs, any product it names and a length outside 200 to 480 words.
5. One Slack card per guide: **Approve** writes it to the collection metafield `custom.buyer_guide` (Setup creates it), **Redraft** queues it for the next run, **Skip** leaves it.

Show it on a stock theme with a **Custom Liquid** block on the collection template: paste `buyer-guide.liquid`.

# Write
## every Tuesday, or /store run guides

# Review
## a button tap in Slack, through the router

# Setup
## once: the metafield and the table

nodes.name: Run from /store
nodes.notes: /store run guides (lane write) and /store run setup (lane setup). Header auth: Store run key.

nodes.name: Write settings

parameters.jsonOutput:
{
  "store_domain": "your-store.myshopify.com",
  "store_name": "Your Store",
  "voice": "Plain, practical and specific. Contractions are fine. Explain a technical term the first time it appears.",
  "max_per_run": 3,
  "min_products": 5,
  "min_volume": 0,
  "model": "gemma4:31b",
  "review_channel": "#review-buyer-guides",
  "search_location_code": 2840,
  "search_language_code": "en",
  "metafield_namespace": "custom",
  "metafield_key": "buyer_guide",
  "spec_namespace": "custom",
  "skip_spec_keys": [
    "spec_url",
    "mpn",
    "manufacturer_url",
    "buyer_guide"
  ]
}

nodes.notes: search_location_code: 2840 United States, 2826 United Kingdom, 2036 Australia (DataForSEO location codes).

nodes.name: Get Shopify token
nodes.notes: Client credentials grant: a fresh Admin API token for this run. See SETUP.md.

nodes.name: Pick collections

parameters.query:
select c.gid, c.handle, c.title, coalesce(nullif(c.keyword, ''), c.title) as keyword, c.volume
from collection_copy c left join buyer_guides g on g.collection_id = c.gid
where c.status = 'approved' and c.gid is not null and coalesce(c.volume, 0) >= $2
  and (g.id is null or g.status = 'redraft' or (g.status = 'too_small' and g."updatedAt" < now() - interval '30 days'))
order by (g.status = 'redraft') desc nulls last, c.volume desc nulls last
limit $1

nodes.notes: Collections with approved copy (Store 4 · Collection copy), top search volume first. Redrafts go first.

nodes.name: Read the collection

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ query: `query C($id: ID!, $ns: String!) { collection(id: $id) { id title handle products(first: 60) { nodes { title vendor productType status totalInventory metafields(first: 40, namespace: $ns) { nodes { key value type } } } } } }`, variables: { id: $json.gid, ns: $('Write settings').first().json.spec_namespace } }) }}

nodes.notes: Its live products and their spec metafields.

nodes.name: People also ask

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify([{ keyword: $('Anything to write?').item.json.keyword, location_code: $('Write settings').first().json.search_location_code, language_code: $('Write settings').first().json.search_language_code, depth: 10, people_also_ask_click_depth: 1 }]) }}

nodes.notes: Why HTTP: DataForSEO has no n8n node. About US$0.002 a search. Disable this node to write without Google's questions.

nodes.name: Build the prompt
nodes.notes: Specs from the products' own metafields; Google's questions steer the headings.

nodes.name: Mark too small

parameters.query:
insert into buyer_guides (collection_id, handle, title, keyword, volume, status, error) values ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, 'too_small', $6)
on conflict (collection_id) do update set status = 'too_small', error = excluded.error, "updatedAt" = now()

nodes.notes: Tried again after 30 days.

nodes.name: Write the guide
nodes.notes: Returns JSON as text; Check the guide reads it, code fence or not.

nodes.name: Ollama Chat Model
nodes.notes: Ollama Cloud by default. Any chat model sub-node works here.

nodes.name: Check the guide
nodes.notes: Flags numbers the specs don't back, products named and the length. You decide in Slack.

nodes.name: Save the draft

parameters.query:
insert into buyer_guides (collection_id, handle, title, keyword, volume, status, revision, draft_html, draft_text, words, flags, questions, model, error, slack_channel, slack_ts)
values ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, 1, $7, $8, $9, $10, $11, $12, $13, null, null)
on conflict (collection_id) do update set handle = excluded.handle, title = excluded.title, keyword = excluded.keyword, volume = excluded.volume, status = excluded.status,
  revision = buyer_guides.revision + 1, draft_html = coalesce(excluded.draft_html, buyer_guides.draft_html), draft_text = coalesce(excluded.draft_text, buyer_guides.draft_text),
  words = excluded.words, flags = excluded.flags, questions = excluded.questions, model = excluded.model, error = excluded.error, slack_channel = null, slack_ts = null, "updatedAt" = now()
returning id, collection_id, revision, status

nodes.notes: review when it drafted, failed otherwise (tried again on the next run only after a Redraft).

parameters.blocksUi:
={{ (() => { const d = $('Check the guide').all().find(i => i.json.gid === $json.collection_id).json; const v = JSON.stringify({ c: $json.collection_id, r: $json.revision }); return JSON.stringify({ blocks: [
  { type: 'header', text: { type: 'plain_text', text: ('Buyer guide: ' + d.title).slice(0, 150) } },
  { type: 'section', text: { type: 'mrkdwn', text: d.text.slice(0, 2900) } },
  { type: 'context', elements: [{ type: 'mrkdwn', text: ((d.flags ? ':warning: ' + d.flags : d.words + ' words') + ' · ' + d.model).slice(0, 2900) }] },
  { type: 'context', elements: [{ type: 'mrkdwn', text: ('Shoppers ask: ' + ((d.questions || []).join(' | ') || 'nothing found')).slice(0, 2900) }] },
  { type: 'actions', block_id: 'guide_actions', elements: [
    { type: 'button', style: 'primary', text: { type: 'plain_text', text: 'Approve' }, action_id: 'guide_approve', value: v },
    { type: 'button', text: { type: 'plain_text', text: 'Redraft' }, action_id: 'guide_redraft', value: v },
    { type: 'button', text: { type: 'plain_text', text: 'Skip' }, action_id: 'guide_skip', value: v } ] } ] }); })() }}

nodes.name: Save the card

parameters.query: update buyer_guides set slack_channel = $1, slack_ts = $2, "updatedAt" = now() where collection_id = $3

nodes.notes: So the review page can find the card.

nodes.name: Slack button click
nodes.notes: Store · Slack router passes guide_ taps here, unchanged.

nodes.name: Get the guide

parameters.query: select * from buyer_guides where collection_id = $1 and status = 'review' and revision = $2 limit 1

nodes.notes: Only the latest draft, still waiting. An old card or a second tap finds nothing.

nodes.name: Get Shopify token for Review
nodes.notes: Client credentials grant: a fresh Admin API token for this run. See SETUP.md.

nodes.name: Publish the guide

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ query: `mutation G($m: [MetafieldsSetInput!]!) { metafieldsSet(metafields: $m) { metafields { id } userErrors { field message } } }`, variables: { m: [{ ownerId: $('Get the guide').first().json.collection_id, namespace: $('Review settings').first().json.metafield_namespace, key: $('Review settings').first().json.metafield_key, type: 'multi_line_text_field', value: $('Get the guide').first().json.draft_html }] } }) }}

nodes.notes: Writes to Shopify: the guide's HTML into the collection metafield.

parameters.query: update buyer_guides set status = $1, error = $2, decided_by = $3, live_at = case when $1 = 'live' then now() else live_at end, "updatedAt" = now() where collection_id = $4 returning status

nodes.name: Update the card

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ channel: $('Read the click').first().json.channel, ts: $('Read the click').first().json.ts, text: 'Buyer guide reviewed', blocks: $('Read the click').first().json.blocks.filter(b => b.type !== 'actions').concat([{ type: 'context', elements: [{ type: 'mrkdwn', text: $('What happened').first().json.note }] }]) }) }}

nodes.notes: Why HTTP: chat.update with the card's own blocks minus the buttons; the Slack node rebuilds blocks from scratch. A refusal keeps the buttons off but leaves the guide in review, so Redraft from the page or /store page still works.

nodes.name: Get Shopify token for Setup
nodes.notes: Client credentials grant: a fresh Admin API token for this run. See SETUP.md.

nodes.name: Create the metafield

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ query: `mutation D($d: MetafieldDefinitionInput!) { metafieldDefinitionCreate(definition: $d) { createdDefinition { id } userErrors { code message } } }`, variables: { d: { name: 'Buyer guide', namespace: $('Write settings').first().json.metafield_namespace, key: $('Write settings').first().json.metafield_key, ownerType: 'COLLECTION', type: 'multi_line_text_field', description: 'HTML written by the Buyer guides workflow and approved in Slack', access: { storefront: 'PUBLIC_READ' } } } }) }}

nodes.notes: Collection metafield custom.buyer_guide. Running it again just answers 'already exists'.

nodes.name: Create buyer_guides

parameters.query:
create table if not exists buyer_guides (
  id integer generated by default as identity primary key,
  collection_id text not null,
  handle text,
  title text,
  keyword text,
  volume double precision,
  status text,
  revision integer not null default 0,
  draft_html text,
  draft_text text,
  words integer,
  flags text,
  questions text,
  model text,
  error text,
  slack_channel text,
  slack_ts text,
  decided_by text,
  live_at timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz not null default now(),
  "updatedAt" timestamptz not null default now(),
  unique (collection_id)
);

nodes.notes: The same table as schema.sql, in case you skipped it.
